name: upstream/filter-default-bare
description: Tailwind's `createUtilityPlugin` accepts a `filterDefault: true` option that suppresses the bare-prefix candidate even when the theme has a `DEFAULT` key. `transitionDuration` and `transitionTimingFunction` use it: `theme.transitionDuration.DEFAULT` and `theme.transitionTimingFunction.DEFAULT` exist (consumed by the `transition-property` plugin's append-default behavior) but bare `.duration` / `.ease` are NOT emitted as standalone utilities. The `-linear` / `-in` / `-out` etc. variants do emit.
